summary: Iter28 backend modularization refactor regression verification — pure refactor, no behavior change expected. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_refactor_regression.py (17 tests covering auth, gigs, projects, admin, profile options, messages, files ACL). 16 passed, 1 skipped. Re-ran the pre-existing critical suites that exercise the moved code: test_messenger.py (messenger module — now in routes/messages.py), test_backups_and_cancel.py (approve/approve-backup/promote/cancel-shift), and test_iter_projects.py (gig+project linking). All 35 pre-existing tests still pass. Frontend E2E smoke: logged in as Owner admin and visited /ops, /ops/gigs, /ops/projects, /ops/workers, /ops/messages, /ops/reports, /ops/settings — all return HTTP 200 with zero console errors and zero HTTP 5xx. Regression pages /ops/va-program, /vas, /customers all render HTTP 200. Registered a fresh worker via /api/auth/register, logged in via UI, landed on /crew feed (308 gig cards rendered), opened a gig detail page (title, pay $25/hr, location, slots, address-reveal notice all correct), profile-completion prompt rendered correctly. No console errors during worker flow either. The refactor (config.py, constants.py, models.py, storage.py, auth_deps.py, notifications.py, routes/messages.py extracted from server.py) is verified backwards-compatible at the API contract level and at the rendered-UI level.
action_items: No blocking issues. The Phase 1+2 modularization (config/constants/models/storage/auth_deps/notifications/routes.messages) is regression-clean — safe to proceed with Phase 3+ extractions (e.g., extract routes/gigs.py, routes/admin.py, routes/projects.py next).

Note (informational, NOT caused by this refactor): the pre-existing failures in test_admin_settings.py and test_va_commission_extra.py were skipped per the main agent's note (env-dependent, real Resend key present in .env). This iter did NOT re-attempt those suites.

Note (informational): The /register UI page has 3 inputs with no name/type/placeholder attributes on the first input — only the email and password inputs have type attributes. Adding data-testid + name attributes to the registration form inputs would improve E2E testability. NOT a defect.
critical_code_review_comments: Modularization is clean — server.py drops from 9,011 → 7,688 lines (~14% reduction). routes/messages.py is fully self-contained and the messenger test suite still passes (8/8 tests in test_messenger.py).

Flat-import pattern (e.g., `from config import db` not `from backend.config import db`) is consistent with /app/backend being the working directory for uvicorn. Verified working — backend boots clean, no ImportErrors observed in supervisor logs.

Login API contract (POST /api/auth/login) returns the user object DIRECTLY in the response body (not wrapped in {token, user}) and sets session_token as an httpOnly cookie. Bcrypt is being used via auth_deps.hash_password / verify_password — confirmed login works for admin (HcobAdmin2026!).
Gig serializer uses `gig_id` field (not `id`) at the document level. This is unchanged by the refactor. Frontend consumers should already handle this.

MessageSendIn (models.py L325) uses field name `text` (not `body`) — confirmed by the 400 response 'Empty message (no text and no attachments)'. routes/messages.py correctly validates this. No regression.

DM ACL enforcement (routes/messages.py): worker→stranger-worker returns 403, worker→admin returns 200 — both confirmed in the new regression suite. This means the `_can_dm` helper (or equivalent) was correctly moved with the messenger module.
